name: Cheesy Turkey and Black Bean Taco Skillet

fit.note: 521 cal in the 400-650 band, 32g carbs under the 35g ceiling, no seafood, scales to 14 by weigh-and-divide; passes conditions but loses on dedup.

reason: Same dish as the live catalog's Turkey Taco Rice Skillet: identical ground turkey + taco seasoning + black beans + shredded cheese + chicken-broth skillet base; the candidate only swaps the rice/corn for a lettuce-wrap-and-sour-cream finish, which is the low-carb version of the same taco-skillet dinner, not a distinct plate (protein + flavor family + skillet method all match; starch is the sole differentiator and both still carry black beans).
also_overlaps: turkey-taco-casserole (same ground turkey + black beans + shredded cheese + sour cream Tex-Mex taco profile, baked-casserole method with tortillas rather than skillet)
cross_protein_collisions: loaded-beef-taco-skillet-bowls (catalog) - structurally the same cheesy taco-and-black-bean skillet in beef; the beef twin already exists
any beef/chicken 'taco skillet' or 'taco lettuce wrap' candidate in a parallel pool would be the same dinner in a different protein - flag for the merge pass
